liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Standing On The Moon** (2 reviews): Listener recalls hearing this song for the first time here; The lyric about San Francisco resonated deeply with the listener [24][25]
- **Blow Away** (1 review): A cool breeze flowed through the stadium during this performance [27]
- **Iko Iko** (1 review): Garcia played this song with unusual enthusiasm and energy [32]
- **Loser** (1 review): Mydland played a heavy key line that suited the song's theme [32]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-07-07.142464.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 182 min [1]
- **gd89-07-07.aud.wiley.7855.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 180 min; rated 4.56/5 by 96 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording features more MIDI usage than previous shows the listener heard; Clear band sound balanced with enough crowd noise for atmosphere [26][33]
- **gd1989-07-07.142784.dts.tobin.flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 176 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]. Said about its sound: Recording is a 5.1 surround mix encoded in DTS format [3]
- **gd1989-07-07.153413.MTX.photoLeon.t-flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 179 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [5]

## Around the show

- Over 80,000 attendees attended this final concert at the venue [24]
- A man nearby was visibly intoxicated and wiggling near the listener [24]
- Listener was moving from Philadelphia to Berkeley shortly after this show [25]
- Listener and a friend stood near the rail in sweltering heat [26]
- Security used hoses to cool the crowd in the front rows [28]
- The stadium was condemned and closed forever after this event [28]
- People lay on the grass in various stages of dehydration [29]
- Fire hoses with drilled holes were used to prevent heatstroke [34]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-07-07.142464.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master Audience Dat; Schoeps CMC4/MK41 mics > Panasonic SV-250 (16-bit/48k); Transfer Info: Dat (Sony PCM-R500) >… [1]
- **gd89-07-07.aud.wiley.7855.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience (was labeled as sbd) [2]. Also: Audience recording transferred via SBD, MC, DAT, and CDR generations [2]
- **gd1989-07-07.142784.dts.tobin.flac1644**: transferred by DTS 5.1 mix by Kevin Tobin; source: DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix; - SBD (shnid = 140152) Recording Info: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90); Transfer Info: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A)… [3]
- **gd1989-07-07.153413.MTX.photoLeon.t-flac16**: source: A photoLeon Matrix [5]. Also: Dan Tepper recorded FOB; Ted Mattes recorded AUD; Charlie Miller handled board [5]

## Art and photos
